evidence.quote: The rappers on that cover, and on the one the year before, came up on the same clock he did. 2009: Kid Cudi, B.o.B, Wale, Curren$y. 2010: J. Cole, Nicki Minaj, Wiz Khalifa, Big Sean, Nipsey Hussle, Jay Rock, Freddie Gibbs.

Gated native renders of Carousel 09–12 establish Carousel 10 as the unique match for the reviewed straight horizontal row: one wide landscape center card flanked by narrow vertical cards. Carousel 09 stacks vertically, Carousel 11 uses horizontal side cards, and Carousel 12 is a vertical column. Evidence is recorded in reports/final-two-native-composition-comparison.json.
